# catalyst Provider

The Catalyst provider is under development. This initial skeleton has no configuration attributes, resources, or data sources and does not connect to Zoho APIs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    catalyst = {
      source = "Edson-Edwin/catalyst"
    }
  }
}

# Authentication will be added in the next development milestone.
provider "catalyst" {}
```
